avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin E (>400 IU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate immunostimulation and increase autoimmune/immune-related adverse event (irAE) risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation; obtain from dietary sources only

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Enhances immune system activation; may increase irAE severity including colitis, hepatitis, and pneumonitis

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Probiotics (>10 billion CFU/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May alter gut microbiota balance and increase autoimmune reactions; associated with increased colitis risk in checkpoint inhibitor therapy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid high-dose formulations; standard dietary probiotics acceptable

caution_supplements.name: Turmeric/Curcumin
caution_supplements.mechanism: Immunomodulatory properties may theoretically enhance immune activation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for irAE symptoms; use dietary amounts preferred over supplements

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild immune-stimulating effects may potentiate checkpoint inhibitor activity
caution_supplements.action: Counsel on potential additive effects; monitor clinical response

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin D (>2000 IU/day)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Immunomodulatory at high doses; may influence T-cell differentiation
caution_supplements.action: Monitor levels; maintain normal physiologic range (30-100 ng/mL)

avoid_foods.name: High-sodium processed foods
avoid_foods.mechanism: Elevated sodium promotes Th17 differentiation and intestinal inflammation; may exacerbate ipilimumab-induced colitis
avoid_foods.action: Recommend low-sodium diet; target <2300 mg sodium/day

caution_foods.name: Fermented foods (kimchi, sauerkraut, miso)
caution_foods.mechanism: Alter gut microbiota composition; may influence immune checkpoint response and irAE manifestation
caution_foods.action: Monitor tolerance; moderate intake acceptable but individualize based on GI symptoms

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase intestinal permeability and bacterial translocation; theoretical risk for immune activation
caution_foods.action: Counsel on balanced, moderate-fat diet; monitor GI tolerance

monitoring_notes: Ipilimumab is not metabolized by hepatic CYP enzymes, minimizing traditional drug-supplement interactions; however, immune-stimulating supplements pose significant risk for exacerbating immune-related adverse events (colitis, hepatitis, pneumonitis, endocrinopathies). Monitor baseline and ongoing CBC, liver/kidney function, TSH, and gastrointestinal symptoms throughout treatment course.
